research_problem: LLM-based code completion may suggest deprecated library APIs because libraries evolve after training; the extent and causes are unstudied
technical_approach: 145 manually collected deprecated->replacement mappings from 8 Python libraries; 28,125 line-level completion prompts from real GitHub functions (9,022 outdated, 19,103 up-to-date) via Sourcegraph and AST/type/alias resolution; 7 code LLMs; AUP/DUR metrics; likelihood t-tests and context-similarity analysis; two fixes REPLACEAPI (decoding intervention) and INSERTPROMPT (comment hint)
primary_contribution: First evaluation of deprecated API usage in LLM code completion with root-cause analysis and baseline mitigations
dataset_benchmark: 145 API mappings, 28,125 prompts from 113,660 Python files; CodeGen 350M/2B/6B, DeepSeek-1.3B, StarCoder2-3B, CodeLlama-7B, GPT-3.5
evaluation_metrics: API Usage Plausibility, Deprecated Usage Rate, Reference Usage Rate; Fixed Rate, Edit Similarity, Exact Match
key_findings: AUP only 9-23%; DUR 25-38% overall, higher for larger models; DUR 70-90% on outdated-context prompts vs 9-18% on up-to-date ones (models follow context); library-dependent DUR (PyTorch 50-70%) driven by minor package-move deprecations; REPLACEAPI fixes >85% with ES >80% on open models; INSERTPROMPT 25.7-97.2%
author_limitations: Lightweight Python type/alias resolution may miss calls; function-level deprecation only; Python-only; selected libraries/LLMs; INSERTPROMPT untuned
analyst_limitations: Overall DUR depends on outdated/up-to-date mix and context-following, not intrinsic preference; small/older models only; possible training-data contamination; fixes require known dep->rep mapping; RAG/model editing only proposed; no confidence intervals; line-level completion not agentic generation
reproducibility: High: code and data released; open models
suggested_extensions: Deprecated REST/OpenAPI operations in LLM-generated clients and agent tool calls; controlled comparison of RAG, model editing and constrained decoding; automatic mapping mining from changelogs/spec diffs; parameter-level and behavioural deprecations; frontier-model replication
evidence_location: Setup p.3-5; RQ1 p.5-7; RQ2 p.7; RQ3 p.8-9; fixes p.9-10 Table V; implications/threats p.11
integrity: Two-column lines merged across columns; tables column-split; figures missing; numbers verified from summary boxes
